SYS Witch takes the witch-tech aesthetic into cosmic territory, building a portfolio around a compact central identity surrounded by orbiting interface nodes. Glowing purple details and a deep space-dark background create an atmosphere that feels simultaneously technical and otherworldly — like a control panel for an arcane operating system.

## Theme Overview

SYS Witch organizes its layout around a central focal point — the developer's identity — with orbiting nodes representing different facets of their work, skills, and presence. This radial structure gives the portfolio a dynamic, systems-diagram quality that feels both cosmic and engineered. The glowing purple accent palette lends the interface a distinctly witchy character, while the tight, compact composition keeps the design focused and efficient rather than sprawling.

## Design Highlights

- Radial orbiting layout with a central identity hub and surrounding interface nodes for portfolio content
- Glowing purple accent colors that establish a cosmic, magical atmosphere
- Compact composition that maximizes visual impact without requiring extensive scrolling
- Deep space-dark background palette that connects the witch-tech identity to a celestial register
- Systems-diagram aesthetic that makes technical skills and connections feel visible and intentional

## Who This Theme Suits

SYS Witch suits developers who want a portfolio that feels like a living system — something with structure, relationships, and interconnected parts rather than a linear scroll. It's a natural fit for those working in systems, infrastructure, or architecture, particularly those who also want to convey a strong personal aesthetic identity.

<Tip>The orbiting node structure works well for visualizing relationships between your skills, projects, and tools. Consider customizing node labels and links to create a genuine map of your technical ecosystem.</Tip>
